final: WITH operator_groups AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(1.0 * gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM operator_groups), kept AS (SELECT record_count, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - overall_avg_ratio AS difference FROM operator_groups CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND avg_ratio > overall_avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(difference) FROM kept
